name: ZCA_ORCH_RT_ASSOC
description: Contains the associations between the Orchestration objects and the transactional objects.

columns.name: ORCH_ASSOC_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration association.

columns.name: ORCH_ASSOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Public unique identifier or alternate key of the Orchestration association.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Language independent object code. For example, Lead, Opportunity, etc.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the source object code. For example, LeadId, OpportunityId, etc.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestrations object.

columns.name: ASSOCIATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the association. Possible values are ACTIVE, EXITED, COMPLETED, etc.

columns.name: TOTAL_OBJS_CNT
columns.description: Number of total objectives present for the current orchestration association row's context.

columns.name: COMPLETED_OBJS_CNT
columns.description: Number of completed objectives for the current orchestration association row's context.

columns.name: SKIPPED_NOTHELPFUL_OBJS_CNT
columns.description: Number of skipped or nothelpful objectives for the current orchestration association row's context.

columns.name: PENDING_OBJS_CNT
columns.description: Number of pending objectives for the current orchestration association row's context.

columns.name: PERFORM_ACTION
columns.description: Specifies the action that user can perform on this orchestration association.

columns.name: ACTION_PARAMETERS
columns.description: Contains the Parameters required to execute the action specified through PERFORM_ACTION field.

columns.name: NEXT_STEP_ID
columns.description: Specifies the unique identifier of the next step to be executed as part of the current Orchestration.

columns.name: NEXT_STEP_SMART_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Specifies the smart action identifier of the next step to be executed as part of the current Orchestration.

columns.name: CURRENT_ASSOC_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether it is the current ACTIVE association or the most recently updated association.

columns.name: LAST_GENAI_EVALUATION_TIME
columns.description: Contains the date and time when the Gen AI evaluation last happened on this orchestration association.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).
